Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter (Project Osprey)

Dear Ms. Rathore,

Thank you for meeting us on 23/09/2021 about your dispute with M/s Sunrise Shipping Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the owners dispute the value of the salvage. The matter is listed before the Karnataka High Court.

Our advice is to claim a salvage award based on the value of the property saved. Please collect the valuation of the vessel and cargo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 41,99,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
